name: Shiva Kar
bio: Second-year BCA student at Amity University Online (expected Jan 2028). I am building a foundation in software engineering with a focus on backend systems. Currently learning C for low-level fundamentals and Java/Spring Boot for backend development. As a hobby, I make games in Godot and Unity using GDScript and C#.

projects.title: Unix Shell
projects.desc: Building a POSIX-style shell to understand process creation, command parsing, file descriptors, pipes, and Unix system calls.

projects.title: Custom HTTP Server
projects.desc: Building an HTTP/1.1 server from scratch using TCP sockets to understand networking, request parsing, and concurrent connection handling.

projects.title: Git Implementation
projects.desc: A simplified Git clone in C to understand content-addressable storage, blob and tree objects.

projects.title: RESTful Student Management API
projects.desc: A Spring Boot backend exposing CRUD operations, JWT-based authentication, and PostgreSQL persistence. Designed to demonstrate REST API design, database integration, and backend architecture.
